external_audio_duck: hold playback duck for whole browser_use task lifecycle, stop per-step TTS clicks
root_cause: browser_step TTS bursts are spaced 8-15s apart, far exceeding _PLAYBACK_RESTORE_DEBOUNCE_SEC=0.9s in external_audio_ducking_integration.py, so the process_tap native helper was killed and respawned (390-675ms) before every step; since playback.started and grpc.response.audio are both dispatched inline-await on the same event-loop coroutine (event_bus.py:464-477), the respawn directly delayed delivery of the next TTS audio chunk by 600-740ms, draining the player buffer and producing an audible click
solution: ExternalAudioDuckingIntegration now subscribes to browser.started/completed/failed/cancelled and holds the playback duck for the whole browser_use task lifecycle instead of per-TTS-burst; _on_playback_terminal skips the debounced restore while a browser task is active

json_contract: validate action.tool format, block malformed LLM tool names
root_cause: json_contract.py:96 built ActionCall from raw_action.get('tool','') with zero format validation; an LLM-produced tool name with spaces/dots/Cyrillic/length>64 flowed unchanged into ToolCallSpec.name and was later sent to OpenAI as tool_calls[].function.name, which OpenAI rejects with HTTP 400 if the name doesn't match its own naming pattern
solution: parse_llm_response now validates action.tool format via _TOOL_NAME_RE (^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,64}$) and raises JSONContractError on mismatch, reusing the existing JSON_RETRY_PROMPT retry path
